from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
s='C1[C@H](c2ccccc2)C=C[C@]2(C(=O)OC)[C@H]1OC(C)(C)O2'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s));ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=24,randomSeed=78,numThreads=4);ress=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=4,maxIters=600);ix=int(np.argmin([e for rc,e in ress]));p=np.array(m.GetConformer(int(ids[ix])).GetPositions());els=[a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()];print('organic energy',ress[ix], 'C0-neighbors',[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol()) for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(0).GetNeighbors()]);
# Equatorial hydrogen on site 21 at selected conformer (as selected in best conf)
normal=np.cross(p[8]-p[1],p[10]-p[1]);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal)
H=min([a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(0).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H'],key=lambda h:abs(np.dot(normal,p[h]-p[0])))
vout=(p[H]-p[0])/np.linalg.norm(p[H]-p[0]);pd=p[0]+2.05*vout
# axis v nearly perpendicular to Pd-C0 and ring normal and away from acetonide, near x-axis
v=np.cross(normal,vout);v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
if np.dot(v,p[2]-pd)<0: v=-v
print('Pd',pd,'along',vout,'v',v,'H replaced',H)
# N bound +v; acetate oxygens towards -v
p_od=pd+2.05*vout
p_oc=pd+2.11*(0.40*vout-0.9165*v)
mid=(p_od+p_oc)/2; w=(mid-pd)/np.linalg.norm(mid-pd)
p_c=mid+0.70*w
# construct acetate with carbonyl oxygen mapped p_oc and single oxygen p_od. center positions and CH3 hydrogens via local reference alignment
acet=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CC(=O)[O-]')); AllChem.EmbedMolecule(acet,randomSeed=15);AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(acet);qa=np.array(acet.GetConformer().GetPositions());print('acet',[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol()) for a in acet.GetAtoms()]);
# Kabsch transform center and O atoms map: acetate C carbonyl index 1, Ocarbonyl 2, Osingle 3
src=qa[[1,2,3]];tar=np.array([p_c,p_oc,p_od]); srcmean=src.mean(axis=0); tarmean=tar.mean(axis=0);u,ss,vh=np.linalg.svd((src-srcmean).T@(tar-tarmean));flip=np.diag([1,1,np.linalg.det(u@vh)]);r=u@flip@vh;qa=(qa-srcmean)@r+tarmean
print('acet distances',np.linalg.norm(qa[2]-pd),np.linalg.norm(qa[3]-pd))
# acetonitrile: N index2, cyano carbon 1, methyl C 0
nitr=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CC#N'));AllChem.EmbedMolecule(nitr,randomSeed=17);AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(nitr);qn=np.array(nitr.GetConformer().GetPositions());srcdir=qn[1]-qn[2];srcdir/=np.linalg.norm(srcdir);goal=v;
axis=np.cross(srcdir,goal);d=np.dot(srcdir,goal)
if np.linalg.norm(axis)>1e-8: rn=Rotation.from_rotvec(axis/np.linalg.norm(axis)*np.arccos(np.clip(d,-1,1))).as_matrix()
elif d<0:rn=Rotation.from_rotvec(np.pi*np.array([0,0,1])).as_matrix()
else:rn=np.eye(3)
qn=(qn-qn[2])@rn.T+pd+2.02*v
# Merge
inds=[i for i in range(len(els)) if i!=H]; elems=[els[i] for i in inds]+['Pd']+[a.GetSymbol() for a in acet.GetAtoms()]+[a.GetSymbol() for a in nitr.GetAtoms()]
pos=np.concatenate([p[inds],np.array([pd]),qa,qn]);
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(elems)}\nPalladium cyclohexene methyl ester, acetonide, bidentate acetate, acetonitrile\n')
 for el,xyz in zip(elems,pos):f.write('%-2s %16.8f %16.8f %16.8f\n'%(el,*xyz))
print('n',len(elems),'Pd idx',len(inds),'acet',[(i+len(inds)+1,el) for i,el in enumerate([a.GetSymbol() for a in acet.GetAtoms()])],'nitr',[(i+len(inds)+1+acet.GetNumAtoms(),el) for i,el in enumerate([a.GetSymbol() for a in nitr.GetAtoms()])])
PY
